summary: Keep Wales Tidy announced the 2026 Green Flag awards on 14 July 2026: a record 330 parks and green spaces in Wales hold the accolade (93 full Green Flag Awards, 237 Green Flag Community Awards), up from 315 in 2025 and 291 in 2024, with Wales leading the world for community-managed Green Flag sites.
title: Green Flag 2026: record 330 award-winning green spaces in Wales, third consecutive rise
